defect_observations.observation: For the alternative 2^(8-3) design (6=12345, 7=135, 8=245) the handbook states that exactly four two-factor interactions (12,14,23,34) are clear and twenty-four are aliased (annex lines 332-337 give 27=46 from I=2467). The held source (E-Handbook PDF p. 1345) says 23 of 28 are confounded and lists 12, 14, 23, 27 and 34 as estimable. The handbook count follows from the defining relation, so it corrects a source error, but the text does not say that it departs from the source.

The 5-level Hyper-Graeco-Latin compact matrix prints E13 in row 3. The source compact display (PDF p. 1319) prints E31. E13 agrees with the source tabular listing (PDF pp. 1318-1319), so this is an unflagged correction of a source typo.

thm:p16-sequential-structural-bridge refers to 'the existing finite structural model', and its annex (line 87) to 'The existing existence and uniqueness theorem', without cross-references to def:p16-finite-scm and thm:p16-causal-solution (finite-causal-models.tex lines 51-106). Its closing negative clause (lines 165-167) is neither proved in annex lines 84-131 nor linked to the witnessing construction in thm:p16-sequential-failures part 2 (body 380-386, annex 552-564).

The converse of the (RP)/actual-history equivalence is proved by describing a truncation of the path proof (1)-(3) rather than writing the truncated calculation out. The modifications are specified, so the steps are recoverable, but the argument is compressed.
Terminal-stage normalization is given as 'sum over a,y in the same way'. The step is a direct analogue of the displayed equation at line 151.
